t: A cheap Linux board with a core you can switch between RISC-V and Arm.
steps: Buy the board from the PINE64 Store.
Get a 5 V 2 A barrel power supply, a microSD card, and a 3.3 V USB serial adapter.
Set the core switch to RISC-V or Arm before power-on.
Download a community Debian or Apache NuttX image from the Pine64 docs.
Flash the image to the microSD card with a free image flashing app.
Connect the serial adapter and open a terminal app on your computer.
Power on and log in at the console.
Join Wi-Fi and run a first Python script.
meta: Open Board. From $12.99. A few stores.
